The '''''Devourer''''' was a [[Rakatan ship]] used by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] during the height of their rule.

==History==
It was under the command of [[Predor]] [[Tul'kar]] and carried a large number of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] when the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]] was tasked with locating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. During the journey, the ship entered into the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] where it was sabotaged by Xesh, who was acting upon the orders of Predor [[Skal'nas]]. Much of the crew were killed as the ship crashed on Tython, with Xesh being the only survivor after managing to flee in an escape pod.
